niche_focus: UK-based luxury home-tour media brand: price-led mansion and villa tours (Florida, California, London, Europe, Bali) plus designer-home features, with Instagram driving viewers to full YouTube episodes.
cta_pattern: Price-first hooks ('What $48,000,000 Buys You in Fort Lauderdale', 'Inside a $70,000,000 Mansion in California.. wait for the basement 😲'); long descriptive captions; 'Watch the full tour on The Luxury Home Show YouTube channel'; listing credit ('Listed with @...'); comment prompts ('Do you think we should tour your home next? Drop a yes in the comment!'); usually no hashtags. Bio: 'Business enquiries' email plus '↓ Full tours on Youtube'.

notes: WebSearch budget for the session was exhausted (200/200), so the Instagram-snippet, paid-partnership and storefront searches and the 3 reel-sample searches did not run. The reel sample (9) comes from the earlier repo topic sweep only. Two different contact emails appear: hello@luxuryhomeshow.co.uk (Threads bio) and hello@theluxuryhomeshow.com (YouTube description). The business model looks like a media brand: YouTube long-form (AdSense), property feature intake from owners, agents and developers, and product/supplier mentions. Whether features are paid is not stated anywhere seen. NexLev channelProfile reported estimatedRevenuePerMonth 0 for the YouTube channel. That looks like a placeholder or uncomputed value, so it is NOT recorded as an income estimate. The repo metrics (data/processed/accounts_metrics.csv) show median views/followers of about 0.08 in the 9-reel sample, low relative to the 2M follower base. The Instagram 'Paid partnership' label was not checked (UNKNOWN). No Amazon, LTK or ShopMy storefront, digital products or courses were seen.
